messages:
Nina: Thinking of doing something low-key this Sunday — creek walk + picnic or the downtown spring fair? who's up? :sun_with_face: :balloon:
Alex: Creek sounds lovely. I can bring a picnic blanket and a thermos.
Maria: Fair for me — there's a taco truck I want to try 🌮
Jordan: Creek + doggos? Count me in for creek. Can bring snacks.
Sam: Fair sounds fun, live music at 3pm apparently. Also weather looks iffy tho.
Lee: I'm torn. Solo surf at dawn then meet y'all at fair? 😂
Olivia: If it's creek I'm down but need a ride from SOMA. @Alex you driving?
Alex: Yep can take 2. Leaving around 9:30?
Nina: Poll time: creek 🥾 or fair 🎡 — react with :seedling: for creek, :ferris_wheel: for fair
Jordan: :seedling:
Maria: :ferris_wheel: (I still want tacos)
Sam: NOAA radar looks okay for morning, should clear up by noon.
Olivia: I can only do fair if it starts after 2pm; otherwise creek.
Lee: Voting creek. Also bringing my bluetooth speaker if fair's not too loud 😂
Nina: Okay looks like creek is edging ahead. Final plan: creek walk + picnic, meet at Crenshaw Trailhead 10:00am. Alex driving (2 seats). Bring snacks, water, shoes for creek. @Sam can you bring a tarp in case of mud?
Sam: Can do. I'll also bring extra napkins and bug spray.
Maria: I'll swing by the fair later and try the tacos — maybe meet up after?
Nina: Sweet. Parking's tight so carpool if you can. See y'all Sunday! :heart:
